 singapore Final round of Assurance Package cash: About 3m Singaporeans to receive up to $250 in December
 The final disbursement in the Assurance Package will be available to eligible Singaporeans from Dec 8. PHOTO: AsiaOne file PUBLISHED ON November 10, 2026 2:20 AM BY Khoo Yi-Hang Singaporeans aged 21 and above in 2027 will be receiving $100 to $250 in cash payments from Dec 8, the Ministry of Finance said on Tuesday (Nov 10).
 This disbursement is the final part of the $3 billion enhancement to the Assurance Package announced at Budget 2023 aimed at helping Singaporeans with their day-to-day expenses.
 Eligible Singaporeans who own up to a single property and have an annual income less than or equal to $39,000 will receive the full $250 share of the disbursement.
 Those with an annual income above $39,000 but under $100,000 will get $150, while those with an annual income of over $100,000 will get $100.
 As long as you own more than one property, this cash payment is limited to $100 regardless of your annual income.
 Recipients will be informed via the gov.sg SMS Sender ID before and after the AP Cash has been credited. Those without a Singpass-registered phone number will receive a letter sent to their address.
 To receive the disbursement by Dec 8, citizens are encouraged to link their NRIC to PayNow by Nov 24.
 Alternatively, those without PayNow-NRIC linked bank accounts but with a DBS/POSB, OCBC, or UOB bank account can share their bank account information at the govbenefits website by Nov 30 to receive the payout via Giro by Dec 17.
 Over the last five years — 2022 to 2026 — eligible Singaporeans would receive up to $2,250 in cash from the Package.
